stories.title: Jordan Spieth Eliminated From FedExCup Playoffs — A Season to Forget

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Jordan Spieth's 2026 season is over.

Finished 52nd in FedExCup — just outside the top 50 for the BMW Championship.

Zero top-10 finishes all regular season. The only player to make the Playoffs without one.

A bogey-free 65 raised hope in Round 1. It wasn't enough.

#PGATour
